bowtie.title: What is a bowtie?
bowtie.intro: A bowtie shows one risk on a single page. On the left, the threats that could cause it. In the middle, the event you never want. On the right, what happens if it occurs. In between sit your barriers — the controls that keep the knot tied.
bowtie.caption_on: Barriers in place: threats are stopped before the top event, and the damage is contained.
bowtie.caption_off: A barrier is missing: risk gets through. SpaceRisk shows this gap as a dashed red line.
explain: Green, amber and red bars show how well each barrier works today.
One barrier can protect many risks — and its health shows up everywhere it is used.
Domain bowties draw every risk in a category on one picture: cyber, safety, finance and more.

texts.short: SpaceRisk is a friendly ISO 31000 risk register where teams keep their risks and barriers up to date every month, and leaders see the whole picture in bowties, heat maps and a financial view.
texts.medium: SpaceRisk helps organisations manage risk where it lives: in the teams. Every month, team members review their risks and check the barriers that protect against them; team leads and project managers submit a short return; and the CEO gets an executive summary with heat maps, bowties and a financial perspective — Value at Risk, expected loss and the return on controls. Everything exports to PDF, PowerPoint and Excel.
texts.long: Most risk registers die in a spreadsheet. SpaceRisk keeps yours alive by making risk part of every team's month. Each risk is drawn as a bowtie: the threats that could cause it, the event you want to avoid, its consequences, and the barriers in between — coloured by how well they work today. Teams review their risks and check their barriers in a monthly cycle; team leads and project managers attest the result; and executives see everything on one dashboard, from a heat map to a financial view that puts a value on risk and on the controls that reduce it. A barrier panel shows which controls carry the most weight and where the gaps are. Domain bowties draw every risk in a category on one page. Top events, consequences, projects and executive summaries export to PDF, PowerPoint and Excel in one click. SpaceRisk can be hosted by us or self-hosted, follows ISO 31000 and comes with 92 realistic showcase companies, from hospitals and airlines to oil platforms and hedge funds.
